acceptance.text: On stand in logs, faults at or above E_N are detected within T_N = 10.0 s in at least Q_N = 0.9 of logs.
On stand in logs, the navigation error at the alarm is at most L_N = 3.0 m in every detected case.

label: SYNTHETIC: produced by a seeded software model in sim/. Not measured on any robot, sensor or receiver. The model and the method under test share an author. Evidence kind: simulated.
title: GNSS log replay harness (synthetic stand in logs)
what_this_does_not_show: Nothing about a real robot, sensor, receiver or building: worlds and methods share an author.
Heat parameters are assumed, proposal values; no component was measured.
The replay harness ran on synthetic stand in logs only; no public or field log was replayed.
No RF level GNSS evidence; faults are injected into the position stream only.
